text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the URA award
ceremony.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All of the year's most illustrious faces
gather
there, including...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин, Михоно Бурбон,
Oguri Cap,
and Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан uses her award acceptance
speech to
challenge every racer in
attendance to a battle
for the top.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
